_doc: How the VO chunks are cut into beats and laid on the timeline. Seconds. Read by scripts/yt/vo-build.py.

_notes.tighten: ElevenLabs v3 leaves 0.5-0.9 s between sentences (138-160 wpm). Every silent gap longer than 0.36 s is cut to 0.3 s, taken from its middle so the breath stays; a laugh or a sigh is never cut (the cut region must be 28 dB under her speech). Protected: the performed pauses (the ellipses at 3, 12, 52 and 60; the [pause] before 8 and 32; the melt at 34).
_notes.extraAfter: Leo, W43: every second counts; air only where the picture needs it. 18: the title transition. 34: one second of silence after 'It starts to melt' (script-deltas #12), the rewind runs inside it. 35: into the product transition. 50: the pass chime. 52: the sweet surprise lands. 61: the second chime.
_notes.silentBeats: 65: the end card holds for YouTube's end screen after the last line
_notes.tempo: ElevenLabs v3 reads at about 169 wpm against 180 on W43 (v2); every take is time-stretched by 1.05 with Rubber Band (pitch and formants kept), applied after tightening.
